# Questions for the client (Session 1)

1. **Swept cash:** What was the exact balance of the pre-petition bank account swept into the DIP account on 3/10/2026 (bank statements)? March MOR ending cash is reported as 1,771,630.00 assuming beginning cash of $0; it must be increased by that amount.
2. **Pre-petition AP completeness:** Besides Mesa ($62,400), Apex ($31,200, paid), Front Range ($7,400) and Grainger ($4,310), what other pre-petition accounts payable / claims exist as of 3/31/2026 (full AP aging and any scheduled pre-petition claims list)? Part 2 LSTC currently shows only 74,110.00.
3. **Payroll detail:** Provide the 3/13 payroll register by employee showing wages earned 2/28–3/9 (pre-petition) vs. 3/10–3/13, to confirm the §507(a)(4) per-employee cap check and replace my 10/14–4/14 time-proration estimate ($294,285.71 / $117,714.29). Also confirm the wage order (Dkt. 9) covered the full pre-petition amount paid.
4. **Mesa:** (a) exact amount Mesa owes on the returned coils and the credit memo, and the invoice/ship dates (to test whether any coil credit relates to post-petition deliveries, which is treated differently than netting pre-petition amounts); (b) has Mesa agreed in writing to Customary Trade Terms (the Dkt. 48 condition) — needed for the motion to add Mesa to Schedule 1; (c) are Mesa's Q2 structural deliveries to be ordered on new post-petition terms?
5. **Utilities:** Was the $28,000 deposit (Dkt. 31) a pure refundable security deposit or partly a prepayment of March usage? Any unpaid March utilities usage accrual to add to Part 2?
6. **Other accruals:** Any other post-petition payables at 3/31 not in the March file (rent, insurance, payroll taxes on the 3/13 payroll, interest/reserve accruals on the DIP)? Confirm payroll tax treatment of the 3/13 gross payroll (withheld vs. employer share, and dates paid) — the activity file shows only gross.
7. **UST fees:** Confirm the 0.8% disbursement rate used for the March accrual against the actual UST quarterly fee schedule in effect, and the quarter-end dates.
8. **Other estate accounts:** Were any other estate accounts (payroll, escrow, imprest) open during March? The MOR covers all estate accounts.
9. **Corbin/H&P engagement dates:** Confirm both professionals were court-approved (D.I. entry dates) and their retention dates, so post-petition fee eligibility can be tested in April's Part 5.
